improvement_relation.basis: The existing entry context now carries the bounded observation preflight result from campaign state. Two focused tests and a live same-checkpoint readback confirm the field is available without a separate campaign-state query; no agent burden reduction is claimed.
not_measured: agent receipt and use of the field across other sessions
agent time or tool-call burden reduction
ambient service fulfillment outside campaign entry context

measurement_limits: The relation establishes a verified context projection change and a same-session readback, not broader adoption or universal delivery.
Agent receipt, intervention-burden reduction, and cross-session effectiveness are not measured.

outcome.implementation_change: Expose the accepted checkpoint summary through continuation_observations and Session.context when a validated summary is present.
outcome.implementation_scope: Bounded campaign observation preflight outcome in entry continuation context.
outcome.interpretation_limit: Discoverability is verified in one session; agent receipt and burden reduction are unknown.
outcome.verified_change: Focused context regressions pass, and the live entry context exposes validated for the same checkpoint previously omitted.

related_work.work_intent_goal: Improve MNCS's ability to observe, interpret, and improve how the environment serves agents working within MNCS.
